ننتحل (form VIII)
# نَنْتَحِلُ (nantaḥilu) /nan.ta.ħi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# نُنْتَحَلُ (nuntaḥalu) /nun.ta.ħa.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# نَنْتَحِلَ (nantaḥila) /nan.ta.ħi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# نُنْتَحَلَ (nuntaḥala) /nun.ta.ħa.la/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
